verdict.rationale: AnyDesk's help center documents a management portal for address books and devices, plus user management with role and permission assignment. That covers the shared address book/console and organization-level access control. Nothing shows policies scoped per group of machines or users. missing for 10: explicit per-group access policies tied to address-book groups, in-depth documentation of address book sharing, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an IT admin, machines and users are organized in a shared address book or console with per-group access policies

citations.quote: Learn how to manage address books, monitor sessions, and manage devices using the portal.
Manage users, assign roles and permissions for your organization, and configure custom clients.
List all AnyDesk clients registered to the account
